title: Eval-task format inspection v1
description: What `tasks inspect <path>` found under a path, from the files alone: nothing is imported, run or converted (dokimi/docs/coding-harnesses.md). One item per task directory or dataset file a format probe claims; a path nothing claims is a single `unknown` item. `details` is per format and open; every other level is closed.

root.description: The path given to `tasks inspect`, as given.

format.description: The probe that claimed the item. `git-lfs-pointer` is a dataset file whose content was never fetched (`details.expected_format` names its format when a config in the scan names it); `unknown` is a path no probe claims.

kind.description: `executable`: an environment and a verifier; `answer-only`: prompt/target samples; `trigger`: skill-selection queries; `localization`: where-is questions scored on cited locations.

items.description: Records in a dataset file; null for a task directory or an unread file.

problems.description: Lint findings: what a consumer would refuse or misread.

consumers.description: What in dokimi reads the item today; `none-yet` when nothing does.

alternatives.description: Other probes that claimed the item about as strongly.

details.description: Per-format structure (metadata summary, field map, references to dataset files, LFS oid and size).
